description:
We are six students from Chengannur at the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 in Kochi. Tackling the "Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer" challenge, we aim to inspire the next generation of space explorers.

Our balanced 6-member squad brings core strengths in:

Coding: Crafting smooth logic and gameplay.

UI/UX: Designing vibrant, kid-friendly lunar interfaces.

Gamification: Turning NASA data into engaging story missions and rewards.

We are ready to build the future of space literacy!
summary: **The Silent Explorers** is a story-driven educational project that introduces school-age space fans to NASA hardware left on the Moon, on Mars and in deep space. Told in five stops, it follows Apollo 11's laser mirror, the Opportunity rover, Sojourner, InSight, Ingenuity and the Voyager probes. Each stop pairs a short narrative with a "Tap for the science" explanation, linking engineering to discovery. Delivered as a scrolling web page with a progress bar and quiz, plus a six-slide PowerPoint with speaker notes, it turns silent machines into characters and inspires young explorers to imagine and build their own future missions.
